normalattack.name: Normal Attack
normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> after a short casting time.
If the {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK} is in Collapse Mode and has at least 1 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK}, Mitya's Charged Attack will be replaced by the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Prism Detonation</color>, which consumes no Stamina: After dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> once, it will continuously consume <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prisms</color>. Each Prism consumed deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Gathers the power of Electro and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

elementalskill.name: Elemental Skill

elementalburst.name: Elemental Burst
elementalburst.description: Using precise calculations, Mitya triggers an explosion that deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>, then generates several {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prisms</color>{/LINK}.

p1.name: Ascension Talent 1
p1.description: Grants different enhancement effects based on the mode the Elemental Skill's {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK} is in:\nStable Mode: For each Prism Mitya has, all nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery;\nCollapse Mode: Upon triggering a Stellar-Conduct reaction, the effect changes to generating 1 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK} every 1.5s for 3s.

p2.name: Ascension Talent 2
p2.description: After being collected, {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prisms</color>{/LINK} will persist for 10s. Additionally, collecting a Prism increases Mitya's CRIT Rate by 5% for 15s. Max 4 stacks. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

p3.name: Passive Talent
p3.description: When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and 1 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK} will be generated every 1.5s for 1.5s. Party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will also be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.\nAdditionally, when Mitya is within a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, he will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.

p4.name: Life Talent
p4.description: In Voxelrock areas, Energy Devices in Stable Mode can enter a special Excavation Mode, rapidly clearing nearby Voxelrock.\nAdditionally, when Mitya is in the party, crafting a Prime Ice Construct Basic Heat Source does not consume power.

const1.name: C1
const1.description: The maximum number of {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prisms</color>{/LINK} Mitya can have is increased to 5. Using his Elemental Skill generates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>;\nWhile the {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK} is present, the active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 50%;\nAdditionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color> is consumed. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

const2.name: C2
const2.description: While the {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK} is on the field, opponents within the field have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 25%. The following effects are also granted based on the mode the Energy Device is in:\nStable Mode: All party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery;\nCollapse Mode: The active character gains 200 Elemental Mastery.

const3.name: C3
const3.description: Increases Elemental Skill Level by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const4.name: C4
const4.description: For every 5 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prisms</color>{/LINK} consumed, Mitya deals 1 additional instance of Stellar-Conduct DMG equal to 400% of his Elemental Mastery to opponents near the {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK}.

const5.name: C5
const5.description: Increases the Level of Normal Attacks by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const6.name: C6
const6.description: There is a 30% chance to immediately generate 1 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK} whenever Mitya consumes a {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK} via the {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK}. Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all party members is Elevated by 20%.

hyperlinks.name: Polestar Field
hyperlinks.description: When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various skill buffs.
